lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\NcGantt\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

2 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.

6 transactions are opened and closed by hand. The trait TTransactional has atomic() since Nextcloud 24 and atomicRetry() since Nextcloud 27, which repeats a transaction that ran into a deadlock, as the manual recommends.

1 timed job does not say whether it is time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 40 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 18 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
Nothing in the app calls 88 OCS routes. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
The app has 91 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
